svg.title: Halo exchange and overlap schedule
svg.desc: Top: an 8-node ring partitioned over two ranks; boundary rows read ghost copies exchanged owner-to-ghost in the forward pass, and ghost cotangents accumulate back to owners in the VJP. Bottom: the interior region computes while the halo exchange is in flight, so overlapped execution costs max(comm, interior) + boundary instead of the serialized sum.
svg.text: Halo exchange — two ranks, one logical ring
partition and ghost map · dashed circles are ghost copies
forward: owner → ghost — field values (pack → exchange → unpack)
execution schedule · interior rows have no halo dependency, so they compute while the exchange is in flight
boundary rows wait for ghosts; interior rows launch immediately — the user kernel is unchanged in both schedules
